projection_compatibility.data_format: one IEEE-754 binary16 bit pattern per accepted scalar beat
projection_compatibility.awq_profile: native asymmetric G128 W4A16 projection outputs; no W4A8 conversion or Scale32 metadata

numerical_contract.decode: Every finite binary16 input is decoded exactly as a signed Q40.24 integer; subnormals are preserved exactly.
numerical_contract.nonfinite: Any NaN or infinity input marks the affected residual/SiLU output invalid, or the complete RMSNorm transaction invalid; invalid outputs are positive zero and never saturated.
numerical_contract.rounding: Round-to-nearest, ties-to-even is used for the SiLU sigmoid quotient, SiLU Q72-to-Q24 boundary, RMS mean division, RMS output division, and all Q24-to-binary16 conversions.
numerical_contract.finite_overflow: Binary16 finite overflow saturates to signed maximum finite 0x7bff/0xfbff and raises saturation.
numerical_contract.signed_zero: Exact cancellation produces +0. Residual -0 plus -0 produces -0. SiLU/gate and RMSNorm exact zero carry the XOR of multiplicand signs.

rmsnorm.equation: y_i = x_i * weight_i / floor_sqrt(RNE((sum(x_j_q24^2) + N*epsilon_q48)/N)), followed by RNE binary16 conversion
rmsnorm.sqrt: 46-cycle most-significant-bit-first integer floor square root producing unsigned Q22.24
rmsnorm.storage: two synthesizable HIDDEN_SIZE-entry signed Q40.24 arrays plus one sign bit per element

silu_gate.sigmoid: Q0.24 rational approximation 0.5 + x/(2*(1+abs(x))), with RNE division
silu_gate.product: exact signed Q72 product gate_q24*up_q24*sigmoid_q24, then one RNE shift to Q24 and one RNE binary16 conversion
silu_gate.scope: This contract is a deterministic synthesizable SiLU approximation, not a correctly-rounded transcendental implementation.

protocol.start: start_valid/start_ready accepts only a legal nonzero element count; RMSNorm requires exactly HIDDEN_SIZE.
protocol.input: State and counters advance only on in_valid && in_ready.
protocol.output: out_valid and every output/status/index field remain stable until out_ready.
protocol.reset: rst_ni is an active-low asynchronous transaction abort and state clear.
protocol.clear: clear_i is an active-high synchronous transaction abort and state clear.
protocol.invalid_start: zero, over-capacity, and wrong-size RMSNorm starts are rejected by deasserting start_ready.

cycle_boundaries.residual_add: one cycle from accepted input beat to visible out_valid
cycle_boundaries.silu_gate: one cycle from accepted input beat to visible out_valid
cycle_boundaries.rmsnorm: after accepted start and HIDDEN_SIZE accepted inputs, 46 unstalled square-root cycles precede the first visible output; each accepted output advances one element
